properties.name: Vasút menti házak
properties.approximationNote: Rough search-area estimate using preserved actual roads, parcels/surfaces and cited locality evidence. Not an official or surveyed boundary. Whole isolated rail-side agricultural/service-house locality east of the railway, whose separate status and distance from the village are documented by the municipal baseline study. Actual access lanes, rail frontage and farmyard context guide the estimate. Outer agricultural parcel joins are inferred, and nearby Szigetszentmárton village streets are not treated as aliases.

properties.name: Virágvölgyi lakópark
properties.approximationNote: Rough search-area estimate using preserved actual roads, parcels/surfaces and cited locality evidence. Not an official or surveyed boundary. Whole compact flower-name street estate in the northern village. The municipal baseline study explicitly identifies the Virágvölgyi planned housing area here; its actual enclosing access/grid pattern supplies the ring. East/north plot joins remain rough, and the wider flower-name public map area is not assumed to be a legal estate boundary.
